players.product: E-Infrastructure site development (earthwork, grading, site utilities) and CEC electrical construction for hyperscale data-center and semiconductor campuses

quarterly_data.signal: Backlog (equal to remaining performance obligations) was $3.01 billion at December 31, 2025 versus $1.69 billion at December 31, 2024, with a 1.6X book-to-burn ratio for 2025; $488.9 million of it came from the electrical and mechanical business acquired late in Q3 2025, and gross margin in backlog rose to 17.8% from 16.7%, driven by a greater mix of E-Infrastructure Solutions backlog and an improved backlog margin mix within Transportation Solutions. Unsigned Awards were $300.7 million ($226.4 million from the acquired electrical and mechanical business), giving Combined Backlog of $3.31 billion versus $1.83 billion and a 1.7X book-to-burn ratio.

quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditures were $77.3 million in 2025, and management expected 2026 capital expenditures in the range of $100 to $110 million.
